root_text:
🛑 Health Alert: 

🇨🇳 China facing a surge in viral outbreaks!

Influenza A, HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus), Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and Avian Flu H10N5 are spreading rapidly, raising concerns. Hospitals reporting increased cases.
